verdict.rationale: Stagehand is documented as an SDK (TypeScript, Python, Go) and an MCP or agent-framework integration. It can launch hosted Browserbase browsers, but nothing in the pack documents a hosted HTTP endpoint for submitting a task, polling for its result, or registering a webhook. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on every candidate path. Hosted browsers and server-side caching are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit for a task-submission API.
